title: A helpful guess can guide search
summary: A heuristic is a useful estimate that guides search. A straight-line distance can suggest which place is nearer, but it may ignore walls or closed paths.
introduction: A heuristic is a useful estimate that guides search. A straight-line distance can suggest which place is nearer, but it may ignore walls or closed paths. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.

blocks.title: A helpful guess can guide search

blocks.text: The estimate helps pick where to look. Checking the actual paths is still necessary before choosing a route.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A helpful estimate is not the same as a proven best answer.
